detector.note: Both revisions are silent for DATA-01..04. Two causes, both observed: (1) the rules key on parcel-derived copies and ReadRawData destinations, not on a parcel-carried descriptor used as an mmap backing; (2) the call site is messageData.ReadRawData(...), and Interpreter.resolve refuses a receiver that is not `this` (analysis.py:711-713), so the function body is never interpreted. A probe counted dest_sites=1/dest_request=1 at the call site and zero ReadFileDescriptor/mmap evaluations inside the body. This is a false negative of the present rule set, recorded rather than removed.

reachability.summary: ReadRawData is the function the pasteboard TLV layer calls on the receiving side. The harness calls it directly; which process can put a descriptor into that parcel, and what privilege it holds, is not established here.
